subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the suitable option.

_________ men and women are paid equally in the labour force and there is no division of labour based on gender, women’s work in the home will have no value.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Unless**" is a conjunction that indicates a conditional clause and means "if not." (जब तक नहीं)
 
• In this context, the sentence implies that the condition for women’s work having no value is the absence of equal pay and the division of labour based on gender.
 
• The other options like "**Yet**," "**Up till**," and "**Although**" do not fit the conditional meaning of the sentence as accurately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Unless men and women are paid equally in the labour force and there is no division of labour based on gender, women’s work in the home will have no value.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yet:** (फिर भी) means nevertheless or in spite of that.
 
• **Up till:** (तक) means until a specific point in time.
 
• **Although:** (हालांकि) means even though or despite the fact that.
